description:
CURRENT AUTHORIZED SCOPE (2026-11-25 user clarification; supersedes conflicting planning-only and adapter-prerequisite wording): Implement the generic capability-driven foundation and adaptive SMTP in this PR. No external repository edits, newer Mattermost/Jido integration, mix.exs or pin changes, or local dependency substitution. Extend existing EmailBridge SMTP declaration; keep existing Jido/Web behavior conservative without metadata. Use compatible test adapters to prove declarations. External adapter work is follow-up, not a blocker. No new callbacks/modules/frameworks; existing capability_snapshot path, CommunicationBridge, FileSettings/Ecto, TransportRequirements.resolve, authorized saves and shared components remain owners. Preserve limited exact SMTP additive metadata test approval only; other test gates and human UX approval remain. No commits, pushes, merges or publication.

Planning only; implementation requires an explicit user instruction. The current handoff in parent zaq-h2i.3 is authoritative for this task and supersedes older proposed shapes and historical implementation comments. Verify live source/Git before acting; historical green logs do not validate this checkout. Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/code-quality.md and applicable service guides. Read DESIGN.md and docs/bo-components.md before UI work. Follow docs/testing-approach.md; existing test behavior changes require explicit approval.

Contract prerequisite: maintain the approved envelope and file_delivery.limits extension specified in the parent. Reuse the existing capability_snapshot/1 callback and CommunicationBridge.normalize_capability_snapshot/2. No file_delivery_capabilities callback or parallel source API without proven adapter contract necessity. Inspect actual Mattermost/Jido/Web APIs and compatible versions; resolve configured-value versus provider-ceiling ambiguity explicitly. Bridge translation supplies only declared facts; shared normalization and FileSettings retain their established ownership. Required applies only for usable file support. No support-status changes invented to show settings. Preserve data-source isolation, selected identity and disabled-configuration inspection. Source-contract gaps are owned with zaq-h2i.4; the exact adapter extension must be agreed before dependent implementation. Historical completion/approval notes refer to prior revisions, not blanket approval for new test behavior or coding.

comments.text: Additional discovered API prerequisite: selected disabled connections cannot use current config_id capability lookup because Bridge.fetch_scoped_capability_config/2 requires enabled:true. Propose an additive configuration-inspection scope on the existing :channel_capability_snapshot request, preserving default runtime lookup semantics and provider/kind/archive checks, or justify provider-scope static metadata where no selected-specific transport facts exist. Concrete consumer: editing a disabled selected BO/SMTP connection. No new endpoint or secret projection. Exact source and scope must be agreed with the metadata contract before implementation.

User instructed continue after the concrete contract proposal. Proceed with the additive metadata extension, shared configuration contract and pure resolver. Preserve current support statuses/raw snapshots, dependency pins, issue 1 and all existing test behavior. Locked adapters without the optional metadata callback remain unavailable/unresolved; no provider-specific inference or ignored dependency edits. Configuration validation may remain incomplete while file sending is unsupported, but required configuration is enforced for supported file delivery and by the resolver. This preserves existing SMTP saves while explicitly marking values required for future file delivery.

Original TDD red confirmed: new capability projection/configuration-scope tests fail on missing file_delivery metadata and disabled-scope lookup; normalization/resolver tests fail for undefined new modules/APIs. Result: 2 properties and 7 tests failed, with 3 checks passed and 126 excluded by the focused API describe selector. Log /tmp/zaq-h2i-3-red.log. Dependency compilation and isolated test database preparation succeeded. New component/SMTP/persistence tests are written and will receive their own red run before wiring implementation. Existing tests remain untouched.

Implementation and issue-level checks complete for this step: final mix q passes; combined original/new regression passes 522 checks (6 properties/516 tests). See parent zaq-h2i.3 for original TDD red/green logs, unchanged test evidence, unresolved adapter metadata follow-up, intermittent existing WebKit E2E failure and remaining UX/coverage/precommit/review gates. Keep in progress until review/landing; no code commit/push authorized.

Completed the approved callback-reuse/ownership correction. Removed file_delivery_capabilities/1 entirely from Bridge, EmailBridge and JidoChatBridge, including generic callback declaration/optional callback entry and file-specific generic helpers. Generic Bridge now contains no file-delivery-specific references; it delegates communication snapshot enrichment by kind. CommunicationBridge.normalize_capability_snapshot/2 owns metadata validation/projection. SMTP returns its existing configuration metadata through capability_snapshot/1. JidoChatBridge matches HEAD/stack base byte-for-byte; current adapter declarations/status matrix and all original Jido tests remain unchanged.

Explicit data-source guards cover FileSettings metadata/support/visibility/validation and selected connections in TransportRequirementsResolver. Existing normalized communication API/UI behavior and configuration policy semantics are preserved. Shared BO fixtures use the existing snapshot response instead of an alternate callback.

TDD: seven original expected red failures before production changes. Focused green passed 163 checks; final broad regression passed 598 checks (6 properties, 592 tests), 179 excluded by the focused Jido selector. Final mix q passed formatting, hooks.verify, strict Credo with no issues, docs and compilation. git diff --check passed. The only changed pre-existing assertion is the specifically approved raw SMTP exact-snapshot assertion; text/thread statuses remain identical and IMAP/unrelated assertions remain intact. Issue 1 source/test hashes still af19ee7478d9b00faf8fbd4b1f8bff984db8eba87fbea736bcb86ff936ee16f3 and fef42b887f2b6293c6bef7bc9b9a12d87b2458b714711e7f81c359b47cbda913.

Current service docs and Beadwork contract/follow-up descriptions now describe existing snapshot reuse and communication ownership; no future task should reintroduce the removed callback or put structured data into Jido's support-status matrix. No new feature E2E authored. No repeat full E2E for this ownership refactor with equivalent user-visible communication behavior; negative data-source scope is covered by unit/component/domain tests. Prior full-browser WebKit navigation blocker zaq-yx7.5, UX approval zaq-h2i.3.4 and consolidated E2E zaq-h2i.3.5 remain open, as do adapter metadata follow-up zaq-h2i.4 and post-review coverage/final gate. No mix precommit, code commit, push, staging or PR publication. Logs /tmp/zaq-h2i-3-reuse-{red,green,q,regression}.log.

2026-11-25 implementation session: user explicitly authorized coding in feat/channel-file-settings, superseding planning-only restrictions, but no commits/pushes/merges/dependency publication or approval bypass. Clean initial HEAD 2107c75e5; current issue descriptions and ordered children inspected. Serena Elixir overview works. Context Mode execution works; doctor reports missing host capture hooks (no host config changed). User explicitly approved only extending the exact SMTP snapshot test expectation with integer types, bytes/count units and positive-value validation metadata, preserving every old value/flag/status and unsupported-SMTP assertion. No approval to change required applicability or attachment support. Approval source: current conversation reply to the scoped test-contract question.

2026-11-25 live-source contract audit (zaq-h2i.3.1), implementation authorized.

Evidence: ZAQ HEAD 2107c75e5 locks Jido Chat Hex 1.2.1 and Mattermost 93025d5205e070eebbecf89e539d32bdf1fde3ff. Neither exposes file_requirements. Sibling Mattermost is clean at c319c6ed9867364e63c81327c5be8d2881e55ea2 and depends on custom Jido f17679337a9975bee43b9540cb08ac5cfc12b86a. PR6 locks that SDK and Mattermost 98cd98c8f4171f2baef3177dfdeb193c607d941f. These pins are not interchangeable with this branch. Existing Mattermost file_requirements/1 returns configured max_file_size, fixed max_files_per_post=10 and explicitly inapplicable max_upload_request_size. It resolves opts before application env, with nil => unresolved and invalid => invalid_configuration. Therefore max_file_size must not be projected as an independently discovered ceiling. The custom SDK wrapper preserves extra result keys after validating the three existing values; no SDK algorithm change is needed for additive metadata.

Other producer gaps: EmailBridge.capability_snapshot/1 hardcodes SMTP/IMAP declarations. Selected SMTP sender (email_bridge_smtp_module, default SmtpSender) and ImapAdapter expose no declaration API. WebBridge hardcodes built-in provider statuses. Configured WebWidget.HostAdapter at locked/sibling 42b7ef71fd43bb62562c05e9f29581e8152a89cb exposes runtime/status/installation, no capability declaration. Built-in web has no configured adapter at all. Web.Delivery owns the existing local delivery descriptor/event contract. Thus moving all facts to selected adapters requires explicit additive source seams, not merely wiring an existing callback everywhere. Sibling web_widget has an existing modified .serena/project.yml; sibling jido_chat has untracked .serena/. Preserve both.

Shared owners verified: CommunicationBridge.normalize_capability_snapshot/2 delegates metadata to FileSettings.metadata/1. Existing valid_metadata?/1 and normalize_metadata/1 only validate/project value/configurable/required, so typed metadata would currently be dropped. Extend these, do not add another normalizer. Bridge remains selection/envelope owner; FileSettings owns pure validation; no new Action or agent tool.

Proposed source-contract amendment for agreement before dependent implementation:
1. Extend Mattermost file_requirements/1 additively with configuration metadata outside capabilities/0. Preserve all three legacy effective values and errors. Include separate declared transport limits (unresolved per-file ceiling, fixed count 10, explicitly inapplicable request constraint), transfer mode and attachment-edit fact. Configuration definitions carry integer type, bytes/count units, explicit configurable/required, and allowlisted validation %{greater_than: 0}; never use the configured max_file_size as the ceiling. Shared normalized value always denotes transport facts; ZAQ settings remain independent overrides.
2. Add a pure capability_snapshot/1 declaration function to the existing SmtpSender, ImapAdapter and WebWidget.HostAdapter owners; concrete bridges call their selected owner and translate only. Missing optional declarations stay conservative. Preserve current SMTP/IMAP/Web statuses. For built-in BO web, add the declaration to existing Web.Delivery (the native delivery owner) rather than creating a synthetic adapter module; this explicit exception needs agreement because config currently has no web adapter.
3. Validate changed tracked adapters through isolated local dependency builds, preserving committed ZAQ pins until a reviewed compatible revision is available. Do not edit deps, import the PR6 stack, publish, commit or invent an immutable pin. Agree whether local-only validation is sufficient to proceed through downstream implementation before publication.

Action reuse assessment: extend existing snapshot and adapter file_requirements operations; no new Action. Declaration functions are local transport introspection, pure/no I/O/no persistence/no actor elevation; BO continues through the existing NodeRouter/Event endpoint. Existing adapter file_validation_test.exs covers legacy configured values and errors; retain it and add declaration/no-I/O/selected-opts tests. Existing EmailBridgeTest exact SMTP expectation has narrow additive approval in current conversation; all other assertions remain protected. New producer tests must verify actual selected owners, not only handcrafted snapshots. Current analysis is static; no test or quality result claimed.

Status: source audit done, contract agreement and dependency integration unresolved. Do not close .3.1 or bypass .4. No production/test/dependency files modified. This is a concrete missing-contract finding under the issue requirement that the exact adapter extension be agreed before dependent implementation.

Scope correction applied before coding. Removed zaq-h2i.4 -> zaq-h2i.3.8; added zaq-h2i.3.1 -> zaq-h2i.3.8. All downstream normalization -> validation -> persistence -> SMTP error projection -> BO -> widget -> review -> UX -> E2E -> final checks dependencies are preserved. External adapter implementation/release remains zaq-h2i.4 follow-up, referencing the contract here. Prior proposed new source callbacks/local dependency integration are withdrawn. Contract: known file_delivery limits retain value/configurable/required and optionally type=:integer, unit=:bytes|:count, validation allowlisted numeric rules (greater_than, greater_than_or_equal_to, less_than, less_than_or_equal_to). Legacy declarations retain compatible positive integer semantics; metadata never grants file support. Unknown metadata types/rules fail closed; no executable validators or dynamic atoms. SMTP adds explicit integer/unit/positive rules using its existing declaration. Jido/Web preserve existing behavior without metadata; compatible bridge test adapters exercise shared integration. No external code or dependency mutations.
